card.name: Was/were describing severity of reported events
card.fires_on: The verb was or were right after an adverse event noun (reactions, infections, symptoms, deaths) that was just mentioned. It comes just before a description such as severity, grade or type.

modes.label: Was/were after event noun
modes.description: A linking verb follows a reported reaction or symptom and leads into its severity or grade.

modes.label: Grade after with
modes.description: The word Grade appears in a short clause giving the severity share of an event.
modes.example: Keratitis was reported in 2.2% patients in LUX-Lung 3, with<< Grade>> 3 in 0.4%.
